text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal or an object. Another key task is object detection, where the computer finds and locates different objects within an image. Computer vision has many useful applications in everyday life. For example, it is used in security cameras, medical imaging and shopping apps. It also plays a vital role in self-driving cars, which need to recognise pedestrians, traffic signs and other vehicles to drive safely.
